reviewer_boundary: This agent authored the source-ledger intervention earlier; this is a fresh read-only audit and replay, not an independently authored or blinded protocol review.

checks.frozen_identity: Current and archived runner match registration SHA; rows/truth and acceptance registration hashes verified.
checks.gold_boundary: protocol_messages receives row only; evidence parsing receives memory_context only. Capture sends archived messages, model and fixed sampling, not truth. Truth is used for validation/scoring outside messages.
checks.source_projection: All 16 cases replayed: perturbing question_text leaves navigation and raw-source blocks unchanged. Adding gold/accepted-answer canaries to the row leaves them out of model messages. All delivered text items remain present in the raw-source channel.
checks.quote_channel: Candidate has three messages: system instruction, derived navigation explicitly marked NOT QUOTABLE, then question and decoded raw-source text with source indices/raw hashes. Instructions require short literal source quotes and distinguish unresolved duplicate matches from consistent repetitions.
checks.generic_ledger: Repeated names are enumerated per parsed parent scope with roles, line locations and raw ranges, independent of question/gold. No answer value is computed or selected. Clipping/opaque-content caution remains explicit.
checks.old_prompts: Recomputed and compared 119 registered old-variant prompts across all seven deterministic-verification registrations; all exactly equal their archived prompts.
checks.unchanged_cohorts: Combined rows and truth objects match their original 10 exposed regression and 6 newly source-reviewed fixture rows exactly.
checks.scheduled_and_acceptance: 16 cases x 2 declared variants x 1 repetition = 32 calls. All 16 candidate cases require correct frozen value, no length truncation, registered format, literal raw/decoded-source quote and no transport/protocol error. None and UNKNOWN remain distinct; zero retries and one capture are retained.

limits: No Cargo, model inference or capture was run; no frozen input/prompt/acceptance file was changed.
Literal presence alone does not establish source-ID binding or entailment; acceptance explicitly does not claim that.
The new six are authored/source-reviewed development controls, not blind independent confirmation.
Source review does not predict model success, qualify a default reader or establish a memory-treatment effect.
